items.title: Traders Are Getting a New Tool to Wager on the Biggest US Stocks
items.description: Investors will soon have another way to bet on the hottest stocks from Nvidia Corp. to SpaceX, without trading a single share.

items.title: Brazil ETF Market Triples in Boom for New Latin America Funds
items.description: Exchange-traded funds are cropping up at a fast clip in local markets across Latin America as investors flock to a swath of new products tailored to domestic demand.

items.title: Barrick Evacuates Chile Workers by Helicopter After Storm
items.description: Barrick Mining Corp. said it safely evacuated workers who had been stranded in their Barriales camp in northern Chile after severe storms blocked road access.

items.title: Australian Prime Minister Albanese to Press Trump on New Tariffs
items.description: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said he will appeal directly to President Donald Trump over new tariffs announced by Washington, describing the levies as unjustified.

items.title: Iraq to Sign Agreement with Syria on Building of Oil Pipelines
items.description: Iraq will sign an agreement with Syria on the construction of pipelines linking oil production sites to global export markets via the Mediterranean, according to a statement.

items.title: Over 250,000 People Flee Wildfires Ravaging France and Spain
items.description: More than 250,000 people fled towns and villages in Spain and France as uncontrolled wildfires moved ever closer to Madrid and Bordeaux, metropolitan areas that are home to more than 8 million people
